gap_details.2018-2019: Observed 2019-02-03 (only capture Aug-Jan unavailable; 2018-07-26 still 2017-18). Common Crawl 2019-06-26 capture identical minus Chamiraju, Garling relabelled Year 6.

Huang left mid-year, Gaulden in March 2020, the rest in June 2020.
gap_details.2020-2021: Closed. Walker -> Carilion PGY-7, Lieber -> Tulane (Jul 2020). Garling unresolved (DMC affiliation on a paper received Sep 2020; no roster anywhere).
